edges.notes: wasi-libc provides C/POSIX-oriented libc for wasm32-wasi and related WASI targets in LLVM-class toolchains.
wasi-libc implements C library shims that lower to WASI import APIs expected by conforming Wasm hosts.
wasi-libc produces object code and archives linked into Wasm modules.
Clang wasm32-wasi targets consume wasi-libc sysroots in standard LLVM distributions.
wasm-ld links wasi-libc objects into final Wasm modules.
Wasm component tooling shares LLVM wasm link flows where distributions package both.
Uncommon paths may layer libstdc++ on wasi-libc for experimental wasm triplets; most C++ on Wasm uses libc++.
libc++ may target wasi-libc-backed sysroots in Clang wasm environments.
libc++abi pairs with libc++ on wasm WASI targets where configured.
